blockingIssues.sourceQuote: The baseline Synthesis pairs company identity with Compose in its top-level emphasis, but also contains a later description calling orchestration “central to the product direction.” That internal tension may have reinforced the technical angle. This does not change the controlled result: the candidate prompt was not sufficient to protect the supplied editorial intent, and this experiment did not change Synthesis because that was outside scope.
